name: Grilled Chicken Quinoa Salad
description: Peppery arugula, quinoa, and grilled chicken with a bright lemon vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 1 tbsp fresh basil (or parsley, finely chopped, optional)

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse quinoa and combine with chicken broth and a pinch of salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until tender, 12-15 minutes. Fluff and spread on a plate to cool.
Pat boneless skinless chicken breasts dry. Season with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika, then rub with olive oil.
Heat a grill pan or grill to medium-high and oil the grates. Grill the chicken 6-7 minutes per side, until it reaches 165°F. Leave it alone for the first 4 minutes of each side.
Rest the chicken under foil 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.

itemListElement.text: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, the juice of lemon, dijon mustard, garlic, honey, salt, black pepper, and fresh basil. Taste and adjust.
Toss arugula, the quinoa, cherry tomatoes, red onion, avocado, and feta with half the vinaigrette.
Top with the sliced chicken and serve the rest of the vinaigrette on the side.
Make ahead: cook the quinoa and make the vinaigrette up to a day ahead. Grill the chicken and toss the salad just before serving.
